relationships.description: The pipeline uses Leiden community detection in a hierarchical manner, applying the technique of recursive sub-community detection.
The hierarchical partitioning enables divide-and-conquer global summarization.
The Leiden community detection algorithm is attributed to Traag et al., 2019.
